answer: Replication cost is booked per seat and unlocks after 30 days of uptime. Days 1 to 29: stake locked, spendable 0. Day 30: 1 bond unlocks. The node records a trellis of uptime proofs, 1 every 6 hours, 120 per seat before unlock. Three misses in a row reset the count to 0. To forge 1,000 seats you pay 1,000 bonds and produce 120,000 proofs. The delta between farm cost and honest cost is the defence. Two seats cannot share a proof tree, because each nonce includes the device serial.
